data.body_html:
Imagine a morning on the Mediterranean: the sun glinting off the water, a gentle breeze, and a pod of dolphins racing alongside your private yacht. That's the Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise 2045 — a unique experience that combines wildlife spotting with a delicious brunch, all from the comfort of a luxury charter departing from Puerto Banús. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or just want a memorable day out, this cruise offers the perfect blend of adventure and relaxation. Prices start at €749 for a 2-hour charter, with options for larger groups and longer durations.

Why Choose a Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline is a prime habitat for bottlenose and striped dolphins, making it one of the best spots in southern Spain for sightings. A dedicated brunch cruise gives you the best of both worlds: the thrill of encountering wild dolphins in their natural environment, and the indulgence of a gourmet brunch served on deck. Unlike crowded tour boats, your private charter ensures a personalised experience, with a skipper who knows exactly where to find the dolphins.

Our cruises depart from Puerto Banús, the glamorous marina that's the heart of Marbella's yachting scene. As you glide past the Golden Mile and towards the open sea, you'll enjoy panoramic views of La Concha mountain and the Costa del Sol coastline. The 2-hour format is ideal for those short on time, but you can extend to 4, 6, or 8 hours to explore further afield, perhaps towards Cabopino or even Estepona.

What's Included in Your Brunch Cruise

Every dolphin watching brunch cruise includes everything you need for a carefree day on the water:

  • Licensed skipper — experienced and knowledgeable about local dolphin hotspots
  • Fuel — no hidden costs
  • Brunch spread — water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment — life jackets and first aid
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — all taxes included

The brunch is designed to be enjoyed at leisure. Sip a glass of cava as you scan the horizon for dorsal fins, or tuck into a selection of fresh pastries, fruit, and sandwiches. If you have dietary preferences, we can tailor the menu on request.

Our Fleet for the Dolphin Brunch Cruise

We offer a range of boats to suit different group sizes and budgets. For the classic brunch cruise, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests) are perfect choices, both departing from Puerto Banús at €749 for 2 hours. These sleek motor yachts offer comfortable seating, shaded areas, and a smooth ride.

If you're celebrating with a larger group or want extra luxury, consider the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) — available in white or grey — which starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski for added fun. Other yachts in our fleet, such as the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86, can also be arranged for this experience. For smaller parties, the Dubhe (8m, 5 guests) or Speedboat (7m, 6 guests) offer a more intimate setting. All boats are available on request via WhatsApp, and we'll help you choose the best option.

What to Expect on the Day

Your crew will meet you at Puerto Banús 15 minutes before departure. After a quick safety briefing, you'll set off towards the dolphin feeding grounds, which are often just a few nautical miles offshore. The skipper will use local knowledge and a keen eye to spot dolphins, often accompanied by seabirds diving for fish.

When dolphins are sighted, the boat will slow down to observe them at a respectful distance, allowing you to take photos and enjoy the spectacle. Bottlenose dolphins are curious and often approach the boat, leaping alongside the bow. The experience is magical, and our skippers are happy to share facts about the local marine life.

After the dolphin encounter, you'll anchor in a calm bay — perhaps Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés — to enjoy your brunch. You can swim, sunbathe on the deck, or simply relax with a drink in hand. The return journey offers stunning views of the Marbella coastline, with the Sierra Blanca mountains as a backdrop.

Best Time to Book Your 2045 Dolphin Brunch

While dolphins can be seen year-round, the best months are May to September, when the sea is calm and sightings are most frequent. Summer also brings warmer water temperatures (around 22–25°C), perfect for swimming. Morning departures tend to have the highest success rates, as dolphins are more active after dawn.

For 2045, we recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance, especially for weekends and holidays. Popular boats like the Astondoa 40 fill up quickly. Early booking also gives you more flexibility with departure times and allows us to prepare a customised brunch menu.

How to Book Your Marbella Dolphin Brunch Cruise

Booking is simple: contact us via WhatsApp or our website, and we'll confirm availability for your preferred date and time. A 30% deposit secures your booking, with the balance due 48 hours before departure. We accept all major payment methods.

If you have any questions about the cruise, the boats, or the brunch menu, our team is available 7 days a week. We're committed to making your dolphin watching experience unforgettable. Explore more of our [experiences](/experiences/) or return to our [homepage](/) to see all charter options. You can also check out our [fleet](/boats/) for detailed boat specifications.

Frequently Asked Questions

What time does the dolphin watching brunch cruise depart?

We typically schedule morning departures between 09:30 and 11:00 from Puerto Banús, when dolphins are most active. You can also request a midday or afternoon slot. The exact departure time is confirmed when you book, and we'll adjust to maximise your chances of seeing dolphins.

How long is the cruise and what does it include?

The standard brunch cruise lasts 2 hours, but you can extend to 4, 6, or 8 hours if you want more time on the water. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, brunch (cava, wine, beer, soft drinks, water, and light snacks), insurance, and 21% IVA. For 2 hours, prices start at €749.

Will we definitely see dolphins?

No one can guarantee dolphin sightings, but the waters off Marbella are home to resident bottlenose and striped dolphins. Our skippers know the best spots and monitor local conditions. In peak season (May–September), we see dolphins on over 85% of trips. If you don't see any, you can rebook at a 20% discount.

Which boats are available for the brunch cruise?

You can choose from our full fleet, but popular options include the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests) at €749 for 2 hours. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats are available on request.

Can we bring our own food or drinks?

Yes, you're welcome to bring extra food or drinks, though our brunch spread usually suffices. There's no corkage fee, but we ask that you avoid glass bottles for safety. If you have dietary requirements, let us know in advance and we'll adjust the brunch menu.

Is the cruise suitable for children?

Absolutely. Dolphin watching is a family-friendly activity, and our boats are safe for kids. Life jackets for all ages are provided. The brunch includes soft drinks and snacks that children enjoy. Just inform us of any specific needs when booking.

What happens if the weather is bad?

If the captain deems conditions unsafe, we'll reschedule your cruise to a suitable alternative date or issue a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely and will contact you at least 24 hours in advance if a cancellation is likely. Your safety is our priority.

How do we book and what is the cancellation policy?

Book via WhatsApp or our contact form. A 30% deposit secures your date, with the balance due 48 hours before departure. Free cancellation up to 7 days in advance; within 7 days, a 50% refund applies. For last-minute bookings, we may request full payment.
